cover_letter:
I am thrilled by Cloudflare’s mission to build a better Internet and the opportunity to shape its unified AI/ML platform. My background designing and operating scalable backend services aligns with the team’s focus on reliable, high‑throughput systems.

In previous roles I have built production‑grade Python APIs with FastAPI, containerized them using Docker, orchestrated deployments on Kubernetes, and leveraged AWS services for elasticity. I also delivered full‑stack features using React and TypeScript, and optimized PostgreSQL data models for fast analytics, ensuring end‑to‑end performance and observability.

While my experience is rooted in backend engineering, I am eager to deepen my expertise in machine‑learning pipelines and generative AI. My proven ability to learn new domains quickly and take extreme ownership positions me to contribute immediately and grow alongside Cloudflare’s Data Intelligence & Analytics organization.
